'''Thralls''' are a type of [[Mobs]], placed into the [[:Category:Crude Parasites|Crude]] Tier.

== ''Spawning'' ==
* Spawns after an [[Assimilated Adventurer]] gets 15 kills and evolves.
* Spawns in groups of 3 to 5, from [[Ubiquitous Development#Level 2|Ubiquitous Development Level 2]] through [[Ubiquitous Development#Level 4|Level 4]], with a spawnweight of 25.

== ''Behavior'' ==
Thralls are Fast Melee Combatants.

* Their Melee Attack is performed through contact damage.
* Thralls are able to traverse faster in liquids by performing small leaps.
* On death, Thralls have a chance to explode, releasing [[Remains|Primitive Remains]] and an effect cloud of stacking Poison and [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]].
** If at least one [[Colony]] is present in the dimension, will become an [[Assimilated Adventurer]] upon death.

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===
* Thralls, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.

== ''Trivia'' ==
* Thralls are known internally as "Mes".
* Thralls spawned when an Assimilated Adventurer evolves will maintain their custom name. Those spawned from a defeated player will bear that player's name tag, while those spawned naturally will have a name tag picked randomly from an internal list. The possible names are those of developers, moderators on the official Discord server, and the mod's financial backers.
